title: Naked Reflections
format: Hardcover, open spine, book block glued to the back board

description.main: Seven years of studio nudes by the cinematographer Peter Suschitzky, made with available light in the London studio he shares with his wife, the painter Ilona Suschitzky. Published by Schilt, Amsterdam, 2015, with texts by David Cronenberg and Sarah Moon.
description.extended:
Seven years of studio nudes by Peter Suschitzky, the cinematographer of The Empire Strikes Back and David Cronenberg's films from Dead Ringers to Maps to the Stars, published by Schilt in Amsterdam in 2015.

Suschitzky made the pictures between film jobs in the small London studio he shares with his wife, the painter Ilona Suschitzky. Her canvases and painted walls stand behind many of the models. He used available light and a film camera. Each session was improvised with the sitter rather than posed, and he printed the negatives himself as silver gelatin prints, scanned for the book. He has called the results portraits of women who happen to be naked. The book runs to 108 pages with 63 photographs in tritone and closes with a short selection of his other work. Texts are by David Cronenberg, Sarah Moon and Ilona Suschitzky. Victor Levie designed it as a large-format hardback with an open spine.

Suschitzky (b. 1941, London) is the son of the Vienna-born documentary photographer and cameraman Wolfgang Suschitzky. He shot his first feature at twenty-two and has photographed around fifty films, among them The Rocky Horror Picture Show, Naked Lunch and Crash. Seven Genie awards came from his work with Cronenberg.
